source_text: Three large-scale RCTs in sub-Saharan Africa, involving over 10,000 participants, established that voluntary medical male circumcision reduces the risk of heterosexually acquired HIV infection in men by approximately 60%, with protective effects observed as early as 24 months post-procedure and sustained over time. [66] [67]
